status: inactive candidate; no hosted execution authorized by publication
activation: VAEROEX_VSI_QUALIFICATION is absent by default. A nonempty immutable JSON manifest is accepted only on VERCEL_ENV=preview during a <=60 minute window. Production rejects it. Shared evidence, qualitative synthesis and failure-accounting release gates remain OFF; any activation requires its own reviewed release decision.

manifest.expiresAt: UTC ISO timestamp, <=60 minutes after startsAt
manifest.slots: Exactly owner_private, demo_private, business_brief. Each slot requires actorUserId, workspaceId, conversationId, requestId (UUID), questionHash (SHA256), approvedSourceHashes (SHA256 array). Private cases require an empty source list; brief requires reviewed Xero and Sheets originals. All chats must be pinned; create/designate the new empty brief chat only after approval.

budget.formula: 3 * 5 * ((192000*0.25 + 8000*0.50)/1000000) * 2 * 1.1. Conservative byte-as-token, cache-write, Fast and regional premiums; verify rates before hosted approval. Not a provider billing hard cap.

durability: HTTP replaces browser IDs with immutable manifest request IDs. Existing actor/workspace advisory locks and request uniqueness serialize reservation. Pending/completed claims do not generate; attempt >1 cannot dispatch. IDs must never be rotated to retry or replenish a campaign. Any unknown outcome stops supervised execution, even though its full slot remains covered by the bound.
scope: No new source mappings, imports, credentials, accounts, policy acceptance or permanent activation. A valid protected manifest does not alone authorize the campaign: approved original hashes are checked before sealing and at serialized dispatch. Ordinary source authority revalidation remains intact.
diagnostics: Content-free hashes, byte counts, closed case IDs, request/manifest IDs, canary booleans and source approval boolean. No prompts, outputs, canary values, credentials or raw sources in receipts. Checks are at actual serialized transport; rejection is a failure, never an isolation pass.
presentation: Only qualification preview hides citation markers/cards. Stored citations, validation and provenance remain unchanged. This is presentation, not an access-control mechanism.
cleanup: Manifest expiry blocks new calls and bounds active transport timeout; it does NOT revoke membership or entitlement. Reserve cleanup time before access expiry, disable only approved temporary membership, expire only test entitlement, restore workspace locks/selections, retain chats/audit, and verify baseline. No production alias promotion or automatic deployment.
localTests: Actual guard/engine and HTTP route with mocked transport/ledger outcomes, plus rendered citation view. No live model or database calls. Existing DB locking/idempotency contract is relied upon; local mocks are not hosted concurrency evidence.
